scores.rationale: The candidate is an incomplete work-in-progress that stops after implementing only `register`-time schema compilation. `ToolRegistry.execute` is completely untouched, meaning it never validates tool inputs and three out of the four tests in the candidate's own `registry.acceptance.test.ts` will fail. Additionally, dynamic `ToolDefinitionSource` functions are erroneously compiled at registration time instead of per-call with a `WeakMap` cache. Most required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, along with documentation updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`, are completely missing.
